map.由股利支付率求留存收益率 使用指南: Retention Ratio from Dividend Payout Ratio User Guide
map.输入股利支付率 DPR，按留存收益率 b = 1 − DPR 计算利润留存比例，: Enter the dividend payout ratio DPR and the retention ratio b = 1 − DPR gives the proportion of profit retained, for analysing the reinvestment capacity and the internal financing headroom.
map.输入股利支付率 DPR，求留存收益率。: Enter the dividend payout ratio DPR to get the retention ratio.
map.填写「股利支付率 DPR (%)」。: Enter the dividend payout ratio DPR (%).
map.由股利支付率反推留存在公司的比例。: Back out the proportion retained in the company from the dividend payout ratio.
map.配合 ROE 算可持续增长。: Combine it with ROE to get the sustainable growth rate.
map.看公司留存了多少利润可用于再投资。: See how much profit the company retains for reinvestment.
map.：留存率 = 1 − 40% = 60%。即盈利的 60% 留存再投资。: Retention ratio = 1 − 40% = 60%. That is 60% of the profit retained for reinvestment.
map.股利支付率 DPR 为 40%: The dividend payout ratio DPR is 40%
map.：b=1−40%=60.00%，即每 1 元盈利留存 0.6 元投入经营，其余: b = 1−40% = 60.00%, so out of every 1 unit of profit, 0.6 is retained for the business and the remaining 0.4 goes to shareholders.
map.由净资产收益率与留存收益率求可持续增长率: Sustainable growth rate from the return on equity and the retention ratio
map.由债券收益率与基准收益率求利差: The spread from the bond yield and the benchmark yield
map.留存在公司就一定好？: Is retaining earnings in the company always good?
map.前提是留存再投资 ROI 高于股东自投回报；低效留存反损价值，需看 ROE 与投: The premise is that the return on retained reinvestment exceeds what shareholders could earn themselves; inefficient retention destroys value, so you have to look at ROE and the investment opportunities.
map.留存率越高越好吗？: Is a higher retention ratio always better?
map.未必。留存率高说明内生资金充足，但只有新增资本的回报率高于股东要求回报率时才真正: Not necessarily. A high retention rate means ample internal funding, but value is only truly created when the return on new capital exceeds the shareholders' required return; otherwise distributing the profit is better and blind retention only brings inefficient expansion.
